spec.title: Dependency-Track
spec.description: What Dependency-Track is doing: BOM imports, vulnerability analyses, notifications, scheduled tasks and API traffic.

spec.title: Status
spec.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the Dependency-Track API server.

spec.expr: max(up{job="dependency-track-api-server"})

spec.title: Version
spec.description: Version of the Dependency-Track API server.

spec.expr: max by (version) (dt_info{job="dependency-track-api-server"})

spec.title: BOMs imported
spec.description: BOM uploads processed successfully in the selected time range.

spec.expr:
clamp_min(
  sum by () (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",workflowName="import-bom",status="COMPLETED"})
  - (sum by () (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",workflowName="import-bom",status="COMPLETED"} offset $__range) or sum by () (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",workflowName="import-bom",status="COMPLETED"}) * 0),
0)

spec.title: Vulnerability analyses
spec.description: Project vulnerability analyses completed in the selected time range.

spec.expr:
clamp_min(
  sum by () (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",workflowName="vuln-analysis",status="COMPLETED"})
  - (sum by () (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",workflowName="vuln-analysis",status="COMPLETED"} offset $__range) or sum by () (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",workflowName="vuln-analysis",status="COMPLETED"}) * 0),
0)

spec.title: Notifications
spec.description: Notifications emitted in the selected time range (new vulnerabilities, policy violations, ...).

spec.expr:
clamp_min(
  sum by () (dt_notifications_emitted_count{job="dependency-track-api-server"})
  - (sum by () (dt_notifications_emitted_count{job="dependency-track-api-server"} offset $__range) or sum by () (dt_notifications_emitted_count{job="dependency-track-api-server"}) * 0),
0)

spec.title: Failed workflow runs
spec.description: Workflow runs that ended in failure in the selected time range.

spec.expr:
clamp_min(
  sum by () (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",status="FAILED"})
  - (sum by () (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",status="FAILED"} offset $__range) or sum by () (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",status="FAILED"}) * 0),
0)

spec.title: Workflow runs
spec.description: Completed workflow runs per interval, by workflow.

spec.expr:
clamp_min(
  sum by (workflowName) (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server"})
  - (sum by (workflowName) (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server"} offset $__interval) or sum by (workflowName) (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server"}) * 0),
0)

spec.title: Workflows
spec.description: Workflow runs in the selected time range.

spec.expr:
clamp_min(
  sum by (workflowName) (dt_dex_engine_runs_total{job="dependency-track-api-server"})
  - (sum by (workflowName) (dt_dex_engine_runs_total{job="dependency-track-api-server"} offset $__range) or sum by (workflowName) (dt_dex_engine_runs_total{job="dependency-track-api-server"}) * 0),
0)
or sum by (workflowName) (dt_dex_engine_runs_total{job="dependency-track-api-server"}) * 0

clamp_min(
  sum by (workflowName) (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",status="COMPLETED"})
  - (sum by (workflowName) (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",status="COMPLETED"} offset $__range) or sum by (workflowName) (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",status="COMPLETED"}) * 0),
0)
or sum by (workflowName) (dt_dex_engine_runs_total{job="dependency-track-api-server"}) * 0

clamp_min(
  sum by (workflowName) (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",status="FAILED"})
  - (sum by (workflowName) (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",status="FAILED"} offset $__range) or sum by (workflowName) (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",status="FAILED"}) * 0),
0)
or sum by (workflowName) (dt_dex_engine_runs_total{job="dependency-track-api-server"}) * 0

spec.title: Notifications
spec.description: Notifications emitted per interval, by group.

spec.expr:
clamp_min(
  sum by (group) (dt_notifications_emitted_count{job="dependency-track-api-server"})
  - (sum by (group) (dt_notifications_emitted_count{job="dependency-track-api-server"} offset $__interval) or sum by (group) (dt_notifications_emitted_count{job="dependency-track-api-server"}) * 0),
0)

spec.title: Notification rules matched
spec.description: Notifications routed to each notification rule (e.g. webhooks, e-mail), per interval.

spec.expr:
clamp_min(
  sum by (ruleName) (dt_notification_router_rules_matched_total{job="dependency-track-api-server"})
  - (sum by (ruleName) (dt_notification_router_rules_matched_total{job="dependency-track-api-server"} offset $__interval) or sum by (ruleName) (dt_notification_router_rules_matched_total{job="dependency-track-api-server"}) * 0),
0)

spec.title: Scheduled tasks
spec.description: Recurring tasks run by the task scheduler: vulnerability data mirroring, metrics updates, maintenance and integrations.

spec.expr: max by (task) (dbscheduler_task_last_run_timestamp_seconds{job="dependency-track-api-server"}) * 1000
max by (task) (dbscheduler_task_last_run_duration{job="dependency-track-api-server"})

clamp_min(
  sum by (task) (dbscheduler_task_completions_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",result="ok"})
  - (sum by (task) (dbscheduler_task_completions_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",result="ok"} offset $__range) or sum by (task) (dbscheduler_task_completions_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",result="ok"}) * 0),
0)
or sum by (task) (dbscheduler_task_completions_total{job="dependency-track-api-server"}) * 0

clamp_min(
  sum by (task) (dbscheduler_task_completions_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",result="failed"})
  - (sum by (task) (dbscheduler_task_completions_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",result="failed"} offset $__range) or sum by (task) (dbscheduler_task_completions_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",result="failed"}) * 0),
0)
or sum by (task) (dbscheduler_task_completions_total{job="dependency-track-api-server"}) * 0
sum by (task) (dbscheduler_task_completions_total{job="dependency-track-api-server",result="failed"})

spec.title: API requests
spec.description: Requests served by the REST API, per second, by outcome.

spec.expr: sum by (outcome) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="dependency-track-api-server"}[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job="dependency-track-api-server"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job="dependency-track-api-server"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job="dependency-track-api-server"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Outbound HTTP calls
spec.description: Calls Dependency-Track makes to external systems (vulnerability sources, package registries, webhooks), per second, by outcome.

spec.expr: sum by (outcome) (rate(http_client_requests_seconds_count{job="dependency-track-api-server"}[$__rate_interval]))
